experiment_template.research_question: Does the promising one-shot boundary-state signal replicate over a complete frozen GLM-5.3-flash 8K matrix after a common provider-deadline repair?
stop_conditions: Any shared provider or instrument failure pauses unstarted cells and retains every outcome.
No round-ten attempt is rerun or relabeled; round eleven is a separately frozen replication.
No within-round task, source, prompt, cap, threshold, or state mechanism change.
The five-minute provider deadline is common to both arms and changes no model-token accounting.

records.falsifier: The complete matrix misses +0.05 paired macro span F1, degrades aggregate file F1 or valid completion, fails to stay below 396,085 treatment model tokens, duplicates or omits a recycled-generation presentation, or violates source, usage, state, or effect integrity.
records.mechanism: For each newly selected recycler generation, construct and inject the fitted receipt-bound projection on only the first dispatched request. Record that generation as presented only after the matching model receipt; omit state on later requests until another recycle creates a new generation. Use a common five-minute per-model deadline in both arms so a two-minute provider stall does not censor the paired experiment; elapsed time is outside the selected optimization cost.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; one-shot receipt-bound reasoning state after actual recycling, evaluated under cumulative model input plus output tokens.
records.statement: One receipt-bound state presentation per recycled generation improves useful native ContextBench evidence selection and reduces cumulative model tokens for GLM-5.3-flash at 8K when evaluated over a complete frozen matrix.

records.research_question: Does the promising one-shot boundary-state signal replicate over a complete frozen GLM-5.3-flash 8K matrix after a common provider-deadline repair?
stop_conditions: Any missing or duplicate recycled-generation presentation, unknown usage, state-cap failure, false fact, false source credit, or effect is an instrument failure.
No within-round task, source, prompt, cap, threshold, state-mechanism change, replacement, or lucky rerun.
Pause unstarted cells on shared provider or instrument failure and retain every attempted outcome.
Round-ten outcomes remain historical; every round-eleven cell is a new separately frozen replication identity.

success_criteria.scope: Complete exposed GLM-5.3-flash 8K one-shot boundary-state replication; no larger window, untouched confirmation, repair correctness, semantic-retention, transfer, or clearance claim.

records.claim: The first cell stopped before state exposure because a fully accounted length-limited model response poisoned the durable ledger and blocked the frozen correction.
limitations: No paired native score or state exposure.
This is instrument evidence, not evidence for or against semantic state utility.

records.next_action: Persist the ledger idle only for fully accounted length-limited responses, prove one bounded correction through the real transport and recycler, retain uncertain failures as poisoned, then freeze a separately versioned H22 matrix.
